title: Clinical and examination quality review rubric
scope_note: Automated validation checks structure and source traceability only. It cannot determine whether a medical claim is true, current, clinically safe, pedagogically sound, or valid for a local examination.
common_checks: Verify every material clinical claim against the cited primary source or current authoritative guideline; check date, population, study design, limitations and conflicting evidence.
Confirm the content matches the named specialty, topic and learning objective at the stated cognitive level.
Check patient context and assumptions: age, sex where relevant, pregnancy, comorbidities, acuity, setting, resources and jurisdiction.
Check red flags, time-critical differentials, stabilization, escalation and referral priorities where clinically relevant.
Verify investigations, interpretation, thresholds and management against current authoritative guidance; confirm local availability and applicability.
Check all medication details, doses, routes, contraindications, interactions and monitoring against a current trusted formulary. Remove unsupported specifics.
Confirm the keyed answer is defensible, the explanation is accurate, and uncertainty is represented honestly.
Check clarity, terminology, absence of ambiguity, cultural/contextual appropriateness and absence of misleading cues.
Confirm the assessment actually tests the objective and is appropriate for the learner level and local course outcomes.

mcq: Exactly one defensible best answer; all options are plausible, homogeneous, mutually exclusive and grammatically parallel.
Distractors represent realistic misconceptions without being partly correct or ambiguous.
No cueing, trick wording, unnecessary negative stems, or answer-length clues.
Rationale explains why the key is best and addresses the strongest distractor where appropriate.
short_answer: Provide an explicit marking scheme with essential points, acceptable alternatives and partial-credit rules.
The expected answer is appropriately scoped and does not reward unsupported detail.
clinical_case: Scenario is clinically coherent with a plausible timeline, relevant positives/negatives and sufficient data.
Tasks assess prioritization, differential diagnosis, interpretation and management at the intended level.
Expected actions include appropriate red flags, reassessment, escalation and safety-netting.
osce_station: Station brief defines candidate role, setting, time, available equipment/data and candidate tasks.
Marking criteria are observable, specific and aligned to the tasks; critical safety actions are explicit.
Examiner prompts, expected findings and global performance criteria are internally consistent.
viva: Questions progress logically from core knowledge to application and clinical reasoning.
Expected answers identify essential points, acceptable alternatives and critical safety issues.
emq: Option list is homogeneous, clinically plausible and sufficiently broad; reuse rules are clear.
Each stem is independent, unambiguous and has one best keyed option; option keys are correct.

paediatrics: Verify age, weight, developmental stage and age-specific thresholds; never accept unsupported weight-based doses.
obgyn: Verify gestational/postpartum context, maternal and fetal status, and time-critical obstetric escalation.
anaesthesia-critical-care: Verify airway, ventilation, haemodynamic and resuscitation claims against current specialist guidance.
pharmacology: Independently verify every drug dose, route, contraindication, interaction and monitoring instruction.
emergency-medicine: Verify ABCDE priorities, time-critical actions, escalation and disposition against current protocols.
forensic-medicine: Verify jurisdiction-specific legal duties, consent, documentation and chain-of-custody requirements.

approval_gates.draft: Generated and structurally checked; not clinically approved.
approval_gates.needs_revision: Reviewer identified corrections; return to authoring.
approval_gates.clinically_reviewed: Named qualified clinician has reviewed factual accuracy, safety and source currency.
approval_gates.exam_validated: Relevant faculty/assessment lead has approved the item for a specified course, cohort, jurisdiction and examination blueprint.
